LOGIC ADVENTURES

Thirty picture puzzles you really play.

Patterns, odd-one-outs, shadow matches, size orders, mazes, secret codes and clue hunts — real logic games played on our own puzzle artwork, with spoken instructions and no reading required.

This way to Class 30 →The class that goes with these adventures: Logic, Thinking & Problem-Solving.
1 Cleared! Fox’s Spot the DifferenceTwo picnic pictures, five sneaky changes — tap every difference you can spot.Spot the difference Play → 2 Cleared! Robot’s Rainbow LogicRed, blue, red, blue… what comes next? Finish three of Robot’s picture patterns.Pattern completion Play → 3 Cleared! Lion’s Shadow SafariA giraffe, an elephant, a crocodile — match every animal to its shadow on the safari.Shadow matching Play → 4 Cleared! Giraffe’s Tallest TowerThree towers in every row — tap the tallest one so Giraffe can cheer.Comparing heights Play → 19 Cleared! Koala’s Sorting StationSix toys, three boxes — sort every toy by its shape, not its color!Sorting by shape Play → 18 Cleared! Fox’s Logic PicnicA puzzle piece and a food each name one basket — match both clues to find it.Two-clue logic Play → 20 Cleared! Octopus’s Shell MysteryPink, blue, pink, blue… tap the shell that comes next in every pattern.Pattern completion Play → 21 Cleared! Unicorn’s Rainbow RouteRed, blue, yellow — hop the rainbow colors in order and lead the unicorn to the castle.Following a color key Play → 22 Cleared! Logic Castle GraduationThree final puzzles guard the castle: finish a pattern, spot the odd one, find the biggest.The grand logic challenge Play →

Every card is one real game. 30 of the planned 30 adventures are playable now — 01, 18 and 25 join the moment their artwork is uploaded. Progress is saved on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom.

FOR GROWN-UPS

What each game practises.

The collection climbs one slope: finishing patterns (Robot’s rainbow, Turtle’s bridges, Octopus’s shells, Dragon’s crystals), catching odd ones (Dinosaur eggs, Monkey’s market, Hedgehog’s garden), matching shadows and sizes (Lion’s safari, Elephant’s circus, Giraffe’s towers), following keys and routes (Penguin’s ice path, Unicorn’s rainbow route, Bunny’s path detective — plus one fully traceable acorn maze), and combining two clues (Owl’s secret code, Raccoon’s clue hunt and secret object, Dragon’s treasure, Panda’s balloons) — up to the Logic Castle graduation that mixes them all.

Ask “how did you know?” after every solve — explaining a rule out loud is the highest level of this whole class.
